hero.heading: Our approach
hero.intro: We provide careful, evidence-based behavioral health care, so more people can live without being governed by what happened to them.

image.alt: Quiet waiting room in morning light, with wood and linen furnishings

items.title: Evidence first
items.body: We use methods with research behind them, and we explain why.

items.title: Dignity
items.body: You are treated as the expert on your own life.

items.title: Steadiness
items.body: A consistent clinician, a consistent time, and a clear plan.

items.title: Access
items.body: In person or online, with transparent fees.

standardOfCare.heading: What every client can count on

items.title: Licensed clinicians only.
items.body: Every therapist holds an active state license.

items.title: Trauma-informed care.
items.body: We move at a pace you can manage.

items.title: A written treatment plan.
items.body: Built with you and reviewed every [8] sessions.

items.title: Clinical consultation.
items.body: Clinicians review cases together, with your privacy protected.

portrait.alt: Jess Rebelo seated by a window in natural light

founderNote.quote: I founded Unleashed Potential Psychotherapy so people could find specialized trauma care without having to search for it. The practice will grow beyond me; the standard will not change.
